headline: Content creation with a point of view.
description: I turn expertise, food and real personalities into social-first video. The work lives where strategy, production and sharp editing meet — designed to build a following, not just fill a feed.

case_studies.role: Social media strategist & lead content creator
case_studies.summary: A content system for an Italian chef in Copenhagen: original formats, daily community touchpoints, food storytelling and a gradual shift from Italian to an international audience.

case_studies.role: Video editor & content creator · Søberg Institute
case_studies.summary: Social video production for a knowledge-led brand: clear editing, motion-led explainers and short-form formats that make complex subjects more immediate on Instagram and TikTok.

approach_items: Content strategy rooted in a clear audience and creative direction
Hands-on shooting and direction that keeps people comfortable on camera
Fast, social-native editing with pacing, captions and motion graphics
Repeatable formats that create recognition, community and momentum

seo.seo_description: Social media strategy, short-form production and editing by Sara Ruffini.
